query:
select
to_char(((diagnosis_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Date & time",
diagnosis as "Diagnoses",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
display_id as "Patient ID",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
contact_number as "Primary contact number",
village as "Village",
clinician as "Clinician",
department as "Department",
certainty as "Certainty",
is_primary as "Is primary"
from "reporting"."ds__diagnoses"
where
((diagnosis_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
>= 
:fromDate
and
((diagnosis_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
<= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:facilityId is null then true
else facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
and
case
when 
:villageId is null then true
else village_id = 
:villageId
end
and
case
when 
:clinicianId is null then true
else clinician_id = 
:clinicianId
end
and
case when
coalesce(
:diagnosisId, 
:diagnosis2Id, 
:diagnosis3Id, 
:diagnosis4Id, 
:diagnosis5Id) is null
then true
else diagnosis_id in (
:diagnosisId,
:diagnosis2Id,
:diagnosis3Id,
:diagnosis4Id,
:diagnosis5Id
)
end
order by diagnosis_datetime desc
name: Recent diagnoses line list
notes: This report lists all patients that have had the specified diagnosis/es recorded. Diagnoses with a certainty of 'Confirmed', 'Suspected', or 'Emergency' are included. Diagnoses with a certainty of 'Disproven' or 'Recorded in error' are excluded.
